exams: Two distinct original100point forms with20scored prompts/five20point domains. Each form covers all12chapter outcomes at explicit bounded depth. Full answers for every prompt, additive5point scoring. Research judgment must be tested through supplied complete artifacts and actual revised writing, not checklist recall or invented external evidence. Calculations/proofs must be complete and conditioned on assumptions. Proposed240minute closed-book/no-code forms with basic calculator; supplied normal constants where needed. Timings/form equivalence uncalibrated.85overall/15perdomain plus critical-error correction and unseen transfer.

form_distinction.A: Construction: given original macro-finance research materials, build a scoped question/literature map, reconstruct specified data, derive a small model/design, report robustness and write a bounded argument/defense plan.
form_distinction.B: Audit and repair: different macro-finance evidence, design and missingness configuration; detect conflicting claims, construct counterexamples, reconcile revised evidence and produce corrected response/portfolio. Must not be parameter-only A copy.

project: Self-contained original research rehearsal dossier plus explicit bridge to real independent research. Supply complete original synthetic source notes (at least two substantive short research arguments, with transparent data/results/limits) adequate for two actual referee reports; literature/evidence map, faithfully reconstructed benchmark and corrected/extended version, theory/identification/design checks, data/ethics/provenance audit, proposal, complete short paper, code/data release and oral-defense response. Seven self-contained tasks and complete instructor artifacts/solutions; meaningful reproducible computation and independent oracle. No claim synthetic demonstration supplies real scholarly novelty or external human acceptance.
project_inputs: Author chooses a coherent original bank-credit question and nontrivial dataset/model. All quantities, units, timing, joins/missing states/version changes and target/assumption distinctions explicit. At least one consequential correction and one alternative explanation or sensitivity/transport failure. Actual code execution reconstructs provided synthetic note, not an inaccessible real paper. Raw and analysis data provenance complete; known original inputs and any teaching fault clearly distinguishable from reader solution.
project_assessment: Five20point domains use architecture categories with clear seven-task mapping and additive rubrics. Complete instructor literature map/two referee reports/proposal/shortpaper/release audit/defense answers required, not merely marking guides. Original research requires separate learner-generated work and actual qualified evaluation. This project is rehearsal and cannot alone certify the canonical original-contribution objective.
real_research_bridge: Project must state concrete continuation deliverables, milestones, access/ethics and novelty review gates for an actual original paper with real external evaluation. The later cross-volume research-portfolio package supplies the distinct capstone submission and defense protocol; do not mislabel it complete here.
support: Root:8prerequisite diagnostic tasks5points each with full answers/rubrics; five oral-transfer and five delayed-retention tasks with full guides; remediation mapped to all12chapters; notation/concept index for all12; volume synthesis and authentic human-review limits. Keep clinical/legal/access rules general and defer actual authority decisions; no unverified current institutional rules.
acceptance: Full author and distinct independent peer readings of exact prompts/solutions/source scopes; portable runtime gates; coordinator assembly and full build/offline/private release. No volume acceptance until12chapters and every assessment component pass. External learner evaluation remains a requirement, not an accomplishment of the book.
